name: bidwall

scripts.anchor-build: node scripts/local-program-keys.mjs && cd anchor && env -u APPIMAGE -u APPDIR NO_DNA=1 anchor build
scripts.anchor-test: npm run anchor-build && env -u APPIMAGE -u APPDIR NO_DNA=1 cargo test --manifest-path anchor/Cargo.toml --workspace
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run test:quotes
scripts.setup: npm run anchor-build && npm run codama:js
scripts.demo:core: npm run anchor-build && env -u APPIMAGE -u APPDIR NO_DNA=1 cargo test --manifest-path anchor/Cargo.toml -p bidwall funded_partial_fill_depletion_and_residual_demo -- --nocapture
scripts.test:kamino: npm run anchor-build && env -u APPIMAGE -u APPDIR NO_DNA=1 cargo test --manifest-path anchor/Cargo.toml -p bidwall tests::kamino
scripts.demo:kamino: npm run anchor-build && npm run client:build && node scripts/demo/run.mjs

description: Funded, term-bound NVDAx/USDC liquidation bids settled through Kamino
